To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) The Isabelle Insider framework enables the formal modelling and verification of policies for insider attacks on airplanes; 2) We have extended Isabelle Insider with Kripke Structures and CTL to reason about dynamic systems; 3) Our case study revealed subtle security assumptions in the policy; 4) We provide a methodology to develop policies that satisfy stated security properties.

(i) the Isabelle Insider formal framework is a suitable tool for modelling and analysing security policies in the context of airplane security, and (ii) the Isabelle modelling and reasoning tools are useful to detect subtle security assumptions and to provide a methodology for the design of policies that satisfy the stated properties.

1. the Isabelle Insider formalization framework can be used to model insider attacks on aircrafts, 2. the Isabelle formalization framework can reveal subtle security assumptions and 3. the Isabelle framework can be extended by Kripke structures for modelling dynamic system states and CTL to reason about temporal properties of policies in dynamic system states.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a framework for the formal specification and analysis of security policies that are sensitive to the human factor.
the development of a methodology for the analysis of security policies that takes into account the insider factor.
the formalization of insider threats and the development of policies to prevent them.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the security policy of a system is not only a question of the technical implementation, but also of the human interactions.
the security of airplanes is not only a matter of technology but also a matter of policy.
the security policy is not sufficient.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed a framework for the formal analysis of policies that can be used for security analysis and that can be extended to include temporal properties.
the Isabelle Insider tool is a powerful framework for the analysis of policies and that the application on an airplane security policy has been successful in revealing subtle assumptions.
the use of formal methods is not limited to the analysis of technical artifacts.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the Isabelle Insider approach is a suitable framework for the formal analysis of security policies in a dynamic system context.
the use of a formal modelling and reasoning framework is crucial to identify subtle security assumptions.
the integration of human factors into the verification process is crucial for the design of security-critical systems.
